risks: Root integration can change inspected working-tree bytes; report hashes are not HEAD equality and must be rechecked at acceptance.

Page production and shared provenance depend downstream on WP-06; adding them as predecessors creates cycles. Lead must distinguish ready implementation contracts from final integrated acceptance, without weakening the Page/Task/agent DoD.
Memory zero-hit/error recency fallback and immutable cached snapshots can return revoked derived content unless shared reads are separated explicitly and source reauthorization is mandatory.
Resource IDs/titles/counts/cursors/link previews/provenance can leak even when body snippets are filtered. Authorization must precede metadata serialization and pagination.
Transport clientId/workspaceId and global provider credentials are not authenticated acting-user authority. RPC-only changes leave process-wide agent tools bypassing ACL.
The rebuildable SQLite FTS local contracts intentionally swallow failures; using void upsert or claimed lease as processed ACK would lose documents and falsely advance watermark.

Shared uuid/timestamptz migration semantics and PostgreSQL search dialect differ from existing FTS5. Selected migrator and service schema must be established before SQL is written; no fabricated timestamp filename.
Raw session search query/args logging and source-derived context export may expose private markers; observability must remain content-free with policy/correlation metadata.
A watermark based on maximum seen event/revision can hide dropped events. Coverage must be contiguous for the accepted cursor/aggregate semantics and failed events remain pending/DLQ.
Physical removal of all tombstone evidence permits stale event/reindex resurrection. Retain deletion revision/fence separately from searchable bytes and derived provenance visibility.

No unread guarantee is possible for bytes already delivered to an authorized owner. Future retrieval/sharing/export must reauthorize; owner-private historical content retention follows accepted provenance policy.

UI/routing, host invocation propagation and service composition files are outside this worker's authorized source scope; this report requests their integration rather than pretending their actual callsites were inspected.
The published reindex response status enum and existing Rox2CanonicalResult status triad require an explicit accepted mapping; type names alone do not prove compatibility.
Full mentions/notifications/sharing/offline acceptance depends on owning packages; a search fixture or this valid preflight cannot certify those capabilities.
